question: This entertainer’s YouTube channel began in 2009 under the name “KSIOlajidebt,” built on commentary videos of the soccer video game FIFA. In 2013, he became a founding member of the YouTube collective the Sidemen. His single “Thick of It” peaked at number six on the UK Singles Chart. A later collaboration with singer Tom Grennan debuted at number four, that week’s highest new entry. His first celebrity boxing match, a 2018 first-round knockout of fellow YouTuber Joe Weller, is often credited with kickstarting the modern trend of internet-personality boxing. He later fought a rival American YouTuber-turned-boxer twice, drawing in 2018 before winning their 2019 professional rematch by split decision. For 10 points, name this British YouTuber, rapper, and boxer who co-founded the sports drink Prime Hydration.

This entertainer rose to fame on the six-second video app Vine before joining the cast of the Disney Channel series “Bizaardvark”. He left that show partway through its second season in 2017, after his neighbors publicly complained about noise and crowds outside his home. He formed the online collective Team 10 and released the widely mocked 2017 single “It’s Everyday Bro,” now a fixture of “worst song” lists and memes. His November 2024 exhibition bout against a 58-year-old former heavyweight champion drew what Netflix called the most-streamed global sporting event ever. In December 2025, he suffered his first stoppage loss, a sixth-round knockout at the hands of a former two-time unified heavyweight champion. His professional record stands at 12 wins and 2 losses, including a 2023 decision win over former UFC standout Nate Diaz. For 10 points, name this YouTuber-turned-boxer, the younger brother of a WWE United States Champion.

This entertainer’s podcast, “Impaulsive,” launched in late 2018 and has amassed hundreds of millions of views on YouTube alone. In June 2021, he went the full eight rounds in an exhibition bout against Floyd Mayweather Jr., landing far fewer punches than his opponent but surviving to the final bell. He signed with WWE in 2022 and won the United States Championship from Rey Mysterio at Crown Jewel in 2023. He later defended that title at WrestleMania XL with help from a rival streamer known as IShowSpeed. He co-founded Prime Hydration in 2022 with a British rapper-boxer he had twice fought, and the drink became an official WWE hydration sponsor. Before all that, he rose to fame on the video app Vine, amassing millions of followers before its 2016 shutdown. For 10 points, name this YouTuber-turned-wrestler, the older brother of a fellow boxer.
